_doc: Machine-checkable architecture rules. include/exclude use fnmatch on relative POSIX paths. severity=error fails check; warn only warns. Recurring review findings -> add a rule here.

rules.why: Secrets in code leak through git, logs and build artifacts.
rules.fix: Read from environment variables / a secret manager; add the key (without a value) to .env.example.

rules.description: EXAMPLE layer boundary: UI must not access the DB directly
rules.why: UI must go through a service; direct DB access breaks the layer boundary and is hard to test.
rules.fix: Move the query into a service/repository and call it through the service.
